newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Conmed Corp rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Conmed Corp rated buy.

text.p: -- Chicago Corp said Friday it initiated coverage of Conmed Corp with a buy rating.
-- Chicago Corp said Conmed's stock price has fallen nearly 50 percent from its high due to a revenue shortfall from its New Dimensions in Medicine Inc (NDM) acquisition.

-- "We believed that this one time event which resulted in a 10 percent reduction in consensus EPS (earnings per share) estimates has created an excellent buying opportunity in this fast growing medical technology company," Chicago Corp said in a report.

-- Conmed makes and supplies medical products, including electrosurgical instruments and generators, electrocardiogram electrodes, minimally invasive surgical devices, wound care and intravenous products.
-- "Despite this shortfall, the NDM acquisition was additive to Conmed's EPS," Chicago Corp said. "We believe that NDM's revenues have troughed and they should begin trending up in early 1997."
-- Chicago Corp said shares of Conmed are trading at about 13 times its fiscal 1997 earnings estimate of $1.37 a share. The 12-month target price is $27 a share.
